title: Survival of the Safest: Towards Secure Prompt Optimization through Interleaved Multi-Objective Evolution
reasoning: The paper focuses on multi-objective prompt optimization for LLMs, specifically balancing performance (KPIs) and security/safety. While it mentions staying within 'ethical boundaries' as a safety goal and utilizes benchmarks like SaladBench (which covers toxicity and harms), it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark moral reasoning, religious values, or ethical frameworks like utilitarianism or virtue ethics.
